bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="deploy/state/help-rich-manual-20261123"
test ! -e "$stage"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = true
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs|cut -d' ' -f1)" = f5c3b09b915031b94c1b2c9ab86b5c4af74a52bc73256dfc758920d714fb3106
mkdir -m 700 "$stage"
gh api repos/seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot/actions/artifacts/14784021998 --jq '.workflow_run.head_sha' | grep -qx '7b24187988d1ec3f38afead7786fed018b8eb42a'
gh run download 45097745650 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$stage" >/dev/null
test -s "$stage/gaybbs.mjs"
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,subprocess,hashlib,re,json,sys
stage=pathlib.Path("deploy/state/help-rich-manual-20261123")
new=(stage/"gaybbs.mjs").read_text()
p=subprocess.run(["docker","exec","deploy-gaybbs-1","cat","/app/gaybbs.mjs"],capture_output=True,timeout=50)
if p.returncode:sys.exit(60)
old=p.stdout.decode()
def chapters(s):
 markers=list(re.finditer(r"^// src/[^\n]+$",s,re.M))
 return {m.group(0)[3:]:(m.start(),markers[i+1].start() if i+1<len(markers) else len(s)) for i,m in enumerate(markers)}
before=chapters(old);after=chapters(new)
wanted="src/bot/operationHelpHandlers.ts"
if len(before)<100 or set(before)!=set(after) or len(before)!=len(after):sys.exit(61)
if wanted not in before or wanted not in after:sys.exit(62)
if hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest()!="f5c3b09b915031b94c1b2c9ab86b5c4af74a52bc73256dfc758920d714fb3106":sys.exit(63)
a,b=before[wanted];c,d=after[wanted]
help_new=new[c:d]
help_old=old[a:b]
if help_new==help_old or "topic === null ? void 0 : \"HTML\"" not in help_new and 'HTML' not in help_new:sys.exit(64)
for v in ["➔","プロフィールの作り方","<b>","<code>","この機能を開く","startCompactProfileEditor(ctx)"]:
 if v not in help_new:sys.exit(65)
out=old[:a]+help_new+old[b:]
mixed=chapters(out)
changed=sorted(name for name in before if old[slice(*before[name])]!=out[slice(*mixed[name])])
if changed!=[wanted]:sys.exit(66)
for v in ["STARTLESS_REPEATED_START_LINK_FORBIDDEN","startCompactProfileEditor(ctx)","registerOperationHelpHandlers"]:
 if v not in out:sys.exit(67)
(stage/"gaybbs-target-only.mjs").write_text(out)
obj={"state":"STAGED","source_pr":73,"source_sha":"7b24187988d1ec3f38afead7786fed018b8eb42a","old_sha":hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest(),"new_sha":hashlib.sha256(out.encode()).hexdigest(),"changed_chapters":changed,"other_chapters_identical":True}
(stage/"checkpoint.json").write_text(json.dumps(obj))
print("GAYBBS_RICH_MANUAL_TARGET_ONLY_STAGE=PASS")
PY
node --check "$stage/gaybbs-target-only.mjs"
echo GAYBBS_RICH_MANUAL_SYNTAX_AND_SCOPE=PASS
